scope: Redraw only the first selected rifleman in the existing outlined infantry style. Preserve his identity and all gameplay measures;

entries.prompt: REDRAW ONLY the rifleman from reference1 in the game's established style shown in reference2. Reference1 is identity only: keep his normal lean adult build, face, grey-green field uniform, steel helmet, dark boots and wood-stock bolt-action rifle. Reference2 is the mandatory DRAWING STYLE: clean bold dark contours, simple flat color shapes, TWO or THREE clearly separated cel-shaded tones, sharp readable folds and face, serious adult proportions. No photographic texture, canvas grain, soft painterly gradients or photoreal skin. Render at high resolution with deliberate clean linework, NOT enlarged low-resolution pixels. Game animation sheet FOUR COLUMNS TWO ROWS, 8 equal portrait cells, whole person and rifle in every cell, broad transparent margins. Each man about 400 source pixels tall; use a wide landscape high-resolution sheet. First row: FOUR front-facing idle poses with very subtle breathing, rifle held lowered diagonally across torso as identity reference. Second row: FOUR LEFT-facing profile walk cycle phases, alternating boots and arm weight, walk in place, no horizontal drift. Match camera and figure scale throughout, same boot baseline. Full head, rifle muzzle, hands and boot soles visible, no cuts or touching neighboring cells. TRUE TRANSPARENT BACKGROUND, zero alpha outside figures. No background, floor, shadows, smoke, symbols, text or grid. The result must look like the clear outlined game characters in reference2, not the realistic painted character style in reference1.

Restyle the EIGHT existing historical game animation poses in reference1 to the clean outlined game-art design in reference2. Preserve reference1 pose layout and actions: FOUR columns TWO rows; upper row walking RIGHT in profile, lower row front-facing rifle firing stance with a small shoulder recoil and recovery. Use reference2's exact lean soldier identity, helmet, face, grey/olive clothes, boots, wood-stock rifle and clear bold dark contours with just 2-3 flat cel-shaded tones. No photographic texture or painterly shading. Draw the whole figure in every cell, at roughly 400 pixels tall, with generous transparent margins and identical scale/baseline across poses. Keep all hands weapons heads and boots in frame. Do not add firing effects, blood, wounds, other people, emblems, words or scenery. This is a redraw of existing neutral game frames, not a poster. Real RGBA zero-alpha transparent background, no white canvas, floor, cast shadows, grid or checkerboard.

Create the final animation sheet for EXACT lean rifleman in the reference and EXACT same bold-outline cel-shaded game drawing style. FOUR COLUMNS TWO ROWS, eight equal portrait cells, one complete same soldier per cell, about 400 pixels tall when standing. His helmet, serious adult face, grey-olive uniform, boots, wooden-stock rifle, proportions and colors remain identical. TOP ROW: FOUR front-facing nonfatal hit flinch phases, 1 starts startled/tenses shoulders, 2 knees flex and torso recoils slightly, 3 recovers, 4 same original lowered-rifle idle pose. BOTTOM ROW: FOUR death fall phases, 1 legs buckle while standing, 2 drops onto knees, 3 rolls onto side toward ground, 4 fully lying motionless sideways along bottom of cell. No wounds, blood, detached body parts, muzzle flash or smoke. All corpses remain WHOLE with helmet rifle hands feet fully inside their cells, with generous transparent gutters. Same scale across fall; final corpse may span almost full cell width. Clear flat color shapes with 2-3 distinct shade tones and crisp strong dark contour, like reference, NO photographic texture, soft gradients or detailed painterly rendering. True zero-alpha TRANSPARENT background, no floor, cast shadow, labels, text or grids. Do not give him a different face, belly or uniform.

historicalScope: Unchanged accepted identity and equipment; no added unit, national insignia or event claims.
